provenance.notes: SWE-Bench 60.47 under OpenHands, 59.20 under OpenCode — NVIDIA reports both harnesses, which is more honest than most cards.
No hallucination-rate benchmark is published for this model, so factuality rests on a knowledge benchmark alone.
Slightly ahead of Nemotron 3 Nano's 71.5 on the same program-checkable benchmark, so there is little interpretive room.
GPQA 79.23 without tools, 82.70 with. Reasoning is the tier's strongest axis.
Terminal Bench Core 2.0 31.00 — the weakest number on the card, and low for a model NVIDIA positions for agents.

provenance.quantNote: Editorial derivation: no drop from the measured bf16 figure. 6-8 bit is effectively lossless on a model this size — the differences that show up at 4-bit and below are not measurable here. Recorded explicitly rather than left to band fallback, which would otherwise borrow the 4-bit number and subtract a point.
